title: 第24章 对战练气九层第25章 一剑惊鸿
content_zh:
“铛”
一道悠扬的钟声响起，响彻整个演武场。
喧闹的人群瞬间安静下来。
张伯谦站起身，目光扫过台下数百名外门弟子，沉声道：“今日，清虚宗外门弟子大比，正式开始。”
“规矩和往年一样——抽签对决，两两相争，胜者晋级，败者淘汰。”
“前十名者，可入藏经阁二层，挑选一门功法。”
“前三名者，额外奖励筑基丹一枚。”
“第一名者，可入灵泉池修行三十日。”
“另，宗主传下法旨，第一名，可被宗主收为亲传弟子！”
此言一出，台下顿时炸开了锅。
筑基丹！
灵泉池！
这些奖励，对于外门弟子来说，简直是天大的机缘！
更何况，还会被宗主收为亲传弟子！
外门弟子，内门弟子，亲传弟子。
三者的地位，截然不同。
只有晋升筑基期，才可加入内门。
而加入内门之后，才有可能成为长老们的亲传弟子。
功法、丹药、指导……
享受的待遇，不可同日而语！

各峰之中，那些练气圆满的弟子，全都眼神火热的盯着彼此，目光中透着熊熊战意。
宗主亲传！
一步登天！
“难怪无涯要压制境界，原来是为了争夺宗主亲传弟子！”
徐长生心头一热。
筑基丹，他需要！
灵泉池，他更需要！
若能进入灵泉池修行三十日，他的修为必然能再上一层楼！
若侥幸夺得第一……
徐长生连忙甩头，他刚刚练气六层，还想在一群练气圆满之境的弟子手中，抢夺第一名，开什么玩笑！
“抽签开始。”
张伯谦一挥手，一个巨大的玉简浮现在半空中，上面开始滚动一个个名字。
数千双眼睛死死盯着玉简。
有人双手合十默默祈祷，有人紧张得额头冒汗。
片刻后，玉简上的名字停止滚动，两两配对。
徐长生目光扫过玉简，找到了自己的名字。
徐长生——赵四海。
content_en:
"Dang"
A melodious bell rang, resounding throughout the entire martial arts arena.
The noisy crowd fell silent instantly.
Zhang Boqian stood up, glanced at the hundreds of outer disciples in the audience, and said solemnly: "Today, the Qingxu Sect outer disciple competition officially begins."
"The rules are the same as in previous years - draw lots and compete against each other. The winner advances and the loser is eliminated."
"The top ten can enter the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion and choose a technique."
"The top three will be awarded an additional foundation-building pill."
"The first place winner can enter the Lingquan Pool to practice for thirty days."
"In addition, the sect master has passed down the decree, and the first person can be accepted by the sect master as his direct disciple!"
As soon as this statement came out, the audience immediately exploded.
Foundation Building Pill!
Lingquan Pool!
These rewards are simply a great opportunity for the outer disciples!
What's more, he will be accepted as a direct disciple by the sect master!
Outer disciples, inner disciples, direct disciples.
The status of the three is completely different.
Only when you advance to the foundation building stage can you join the inner sect.
Only after joining the inner sect can one become the direct disciple of the elders.
Exercises, elixirs, guidance...
The treatment you enjoy is unparalleled!
Among the peaks, those disciples who had perfected their qi training all stared at each other with fiery eyes, filled with fighting intent.
Personally passed down by the sect master!
Reach the sky in one step!
"No wonder Wuya wants to suppress the realm. It turns out to be to compete for the sect master's direct disciples!"
Xu Changsheng felt hot in his heart.
Foundation Building Pill, he needs it!
He needs Lingquan Pool even more!
If he can enter the Lingquan Pool to practice for thirty days, his cultivation level will definitely reach a higher level!
If you are lucky enough to win first place...
Xu Changsheng shook his head quickly. He had just practiced the sixth level of qi training, and he still wanted to win the first place among a group of disciples who had reached the state of perfect qi training. What a joke!
"The drawing of lots begins."
Zhang Boqian waved his hand, and a huge jade slip appeared in mid-air, with names starting to scroll on it.
Thousands of pairs of eyes stared at the jade slip.
Some people clasped their hands together and prayed silently, while others were so nervous that sweat broke out on their foreheads.
After a while, the names on the jade slips stopped scrolling and were paired up.
Xu Changsheng glanced at the jade slip and found his name.
Xu Changsheng - Zhao Sihai.
